reason: Credible senior delivery evidence, but nothing that shows ownership of a team, a roadmap or a budget, which is the thing the role is hiring for.

screen_notes: Cost consolidation with build times held flat is a real result and reads as ownership of a system.
Four years at the prior employer show no achievements at all, which a screener will notice.
interview_attacks: Who reported to you, and what was the budget you controlled?
The CI consolidation crossed three teams. Did you own that decision or influence it?
What happened at Acme Retail Group for four years?

fix_in_document: Lead with the cost outcome rather than the on-call work; it is the only business outcome in the document.
State the scope of the CI consolidation explicitly: three teams, shared fleet, per-team quotas.
needs_new_evidence: Any evidence of line management, headcount, or budget ownership.
An outcome, not an output, from the on-call redesign.
Anything usable from the four years at Acme Retail Group.
top_changes: Capture evidence of team, budget or roadmap ownership. Without it this role is a reach whatever the document says.
Convert the on-call redesign from an output into a business outcome by recording what it saved.
Fill the Acme Retail Group gap, or expect to be asked about it.
